name: pstack-claude
description: Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Gemini, and Prime Agent versions of Poteto's pstack. Rigorous agent workflows with Cursor primitives translated for other harnesses.
one_liner: A set of pre-written playbooks that make an AI coding assistant behave like a careful senior engineer — reproducing bugs, checking its own work, bringing in a second opinion for tricky changes — instead of just guessing.
buyer: A developer who already uses AI coding assistants daily and wants more reliable output on bug fixes and features, not a non-technical business buyer.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs it across client projects to get more consistent, verified bug fixes from their AI tooling, reducing rework.
A small dev shop standardizes every engineer's AI coding setup on it so junior developers get senior-level review built into their workflow.
An open-source maintainer uses the PR maintenance playbook to triage and fix issues faster with less manual review burden.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup/customization consulting for dev teams who want a tuned version of this workflow stack for their specific codebase.
Bundle it as part of a broader 'AI-assisted engineering process' training or workshop sold to engineering teams.

steal_this: This is a developer productivity tool with no direct end-customer market; honestly, there's no real weekend business here beyond using it yourself or teaching a workshop on AI-assisted engineering practices.
